job.question: In the Los Angeles City Employees' Retirement System (LACERS) actuarial RFP, how many years of experience must the lead actuary have?
job.expected_facts: At least 15 years of experience with major public employee retirement systems, including at least 3 years with California public pension fund clients similar to LACERS.
job.acceptance: Accept 15 total and three California years. Do not require credential details unrelated to the years asked.

reviews.reason: This is an Illinois FPIF private-markets investment RFP, not the LACERS actuarial RFP. Its ten-year minimum applies to a lead consultant, CIO, or other senior staff member, not a lead actuary; it does not support the requested experience requirements.
quotes: Firefighters’ Pension Investment Fund Request for Proposals for Private Markets Investment Consulting and Discretionary OCIO Advisory Services February 13, 2023
The Respondent has a lead Consultant, CIO, or other senior staff member assigned to the account with at least ten (10) years of industry experience as of December 31, 2022.
